original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚说唱歌手Odumodublvck指控袭击案对方提交伪造医院报告
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚说唱歌手Odumodublvck在NewsCentral TV采访中指控，对其提起袭击诉讼的男子Levi Ogbogiri（又名Kraziecent）在法庭上提交了伪造的医院报告。该诉讼于2025年11月提起，Ogbogiri指控Odumodublvck于2024年12月16日在一场公开活动中对其施袭，造成其受伤、情绪困扰及iPhone 15 Pro Max损坏。上述指控目前仅来自单一来源报道，尚未获得独立证实。

key_facts.fact: Odumodublvck指控对方在法庭提交伪造医院报告
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Nigerian rapper, Odumodublvck, has accused the man who instituted an assault case against him of presenting a falsified hospital report in court.

key_facts.fact: 该诉讼由Levi Ogbogiri于2025年11月提起
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The suit was filed in November 2025 by Levi Ogbogiri, popularly known as Kraziecent

key_facts.fact: Ogbogiri指控Odumodublvck于2024年12月16日在公开活动中对其施袭
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: who accused Odumodublvck of assaulting him at a public event on December 16, 2024

key_facts.fact: Ogbogiri称事件造成其受伤、情绪困扰及手机损坏
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ogbogiri alleged that the incident caused him injuries, emotional distress and damage to his iPhone 15 Pro Max.

uncertainties: 伪造医院报告的说法仅为Odumodublvck单方指控，尚未证实
袭击指控本身亦为Ogbogiri单方主张，未获司法认定
目前仅一个来源（Punch）报道，缺乏交叉验证
